description: Tokenization and morphology via StanzaEngine (Hebrew model). Wave 6a: infrastructure smoke cases only.
notes: Gold calibrated against stanza 1.11.1, Hebrew model. Wave 6a provides 3 smoke cases that prove the pipeline is wired correctly. These are NOT a morphology contract validation. Wave 6b (C02 implementation) will add: full lemma paradigm tests, POS consistency across word classes, morphological feature coverage, sentence boundary tests, and multi-sentence inputs.

cases.description: Single interjection — שלום. 1 token, no morphological features. Tests: minimum non-empty input.

tokens.notes: INTJ has no features in Hebrew Stanza model. morph='' (empty string, not None).

cases.notes: Minimum valid case. Proves: process() returns non-empty output for 1-word input; INTJ POS assigned; lemma equals surface form; morph is empty string (not null).

cases.description: Definite article prefix + noun + verb — הכלב רץ. Tests Hebrew prefix detachment: 'הכלב' splits into [ה DET, כלב NOUN].

tokens.notes: Definite article detached from noun. Surface 'הכלב' → 2 tokens: ה + כלב.
Past tense verb, 3rd person masc sing. morph_contains used (not exact) for version robustness.

cases.notes: Key C02 contract: Hebrew definite article prefix is detached by Stanza tokenizer. 'הכלב' (the dog) → 2 tokens: ה (DET) + כלב (NOUN). Token count=3, not 2. This must be documented in C02 implementation wave as an explicit invariant.

cases.description: Noun + adjective — ספר גדול. Tests basic NOUN/ADJ POS assignment.

tokens.notes: Masculine singular adjective agreeing with noun.

cases.notes: Tests NOUN+ADJ sequence — a pattern central to the NP extractor (C05). Confirms that lemma equals surface form for dictionary-form lemmas. morph_contains used for version robustness.
